name: Mordenkainen's Sword

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

targets.description: a creature within 5 feet of the sword, each attack

sustain.label: Mordenkainen's Sword: strike
sustain.help: A Bonus Action: the sword flies up to 30 ft and makes a melee spell attack against a creature within 5 ft of it.

summary: A floating force blade: melee spell attacks for 4d12 + your modifier Force damage, again each turn as a Bonus Action.
text: A spectral sword appears in range and you make a melee spell attack against a creature within 5 feet of it, dealing 4d12 + your spellcasting modifier Force damage on a hit. On later turns a Bonus Action moves it up to 30 feet and repeats the attack.
